title: Implement CRUD endpoints with Zod validation
description: Implement all 5 CRUD endpoints for /api/notes with Zod validation schemas in Express API.
steps: Define Zod schemas: createNoteSchema (title: string min 1 max 200, content: string min 1 max 10000), updateNoteSchema (same, all optional), noteIdParamSchema (uuid)
Implement GET /api/notes - list all notes ordered by updated_at DESC
Implement GET /api/notes/:id - get single note by UUID
Implement POST /api/notes - create note with validation, return 201 with created note
Implement PUT /api/notes/:id - update note with validation, return updated note
Add error handling middleware for 400 (validation), 404 (not found), 500 (server)
acceptance_criteria: All 5 endpoints (GET list, GET by id, POST, PUT, DELETE) respond correctly to valid requests
POST/PUT with invalid body (missing/empty/too-long fields) return 400
